# Workflow jobs that are not yet gated on `github.repository`.
#
# This file is the work list for the release pipeline split. It started at 52
# jobs across 17 workflows -- nothing in the tree gated on repository identity
# -- and is now empty: every job is either gated to one repository or listed
# in job-gating-runs-in-mirror.txt as running in both.
#
# It is kept rather than deleted so that the mechanism stays visible. A new
# ungated job fails `.github/scripts/validate-job-gating.sh`, and adding
# a line here to quiet it is a deliberate, reviewable act rather than an
# invisible one. An entry that no longer names an ungated job also fails, so
# the list cannot drift.
#
# Format: <workflow file>:<job id>. Blank lines and # comments are ignored.
